SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM dim_product_old WHERE category = 'Garden'
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  dd.fiscal_period,
  dd.fiscal_year,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = fsl.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  dd.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fsl.channel_code = 'ST' THEN fsl.receipt_id END) as store_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fsl.channel_code = 'WB' THEN fsl.receipt_id END) as web_receipts
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = fsl.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_period
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  dd.fiscal_period,
  SUM(frl.refund_net) as return_refunds
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = frl.return_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = frl.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_period
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  dd.fiscal_period,
  dd.fiscal_year,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales_before_returns,
  COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as returns,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = fsl.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON frl.sales_line_id = fsl.sales_line_id
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as total_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN frl.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN fsl.sales_line_id END) as lines_with_returns
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = fsl.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON frl.sales_line_id = fsl.sales_line_id
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND dpo.category = 'Garden'

WITH garden_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    dd.fiscal_period,
    dd.fiscal_year,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as period_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = fsl.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
    AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
  GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period
),
garden_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    dd.fiscal_period,
    dd.fiscal_year,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) as period_returns
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = frl.return_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = frl.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
    AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
  GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  gs.fiscal_year,
  gs.fiscal_period,
  gs.period_sales,
  COALESCE(gr.period_returns, 0) as period_returns,
  gs.period_sales - COALESCE(gr.period_returns, 0) as net_sales
FROM garden_sales gs
LEFT JOIN garden_returns gr USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY gs.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.sku) as unique_skus,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dpo.sku IS NULL THEN dp.sku END) as orphan_skus
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = fsl.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12

SELECT 
  ref.fiscal_year,
  ref.fiscal_period,
  ref.fiscal_period_label,
  ref.period_start_date,
  ref.period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar ref
WHERE ref.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND ref.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
ORDER BY ref.fiscal_period

WITH sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
    dd.fiscal_year,
    dd.fiscal_period,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as period_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = fsl.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
    AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
  GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period
),
returns_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
    dd.fiscal_year,
    dd.fiscal_period,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) as period_returns
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = frl.return_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = frl.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
    AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
  GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  s.fiscal_year,
  s.fiscal_period,
  s.period_sales - COALESCE(r.period_returns, 0) as net_sales
FROM sales_by_period s
LEFT JOIN returns_by_period r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY s.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  dd.fiscal_period,
  CASE WHEN fsl.channel_code = 'ST' THEN 'Store' ELSE 'Web' END as channel,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = fsl.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dpo.sku = dp.sku AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_period, fsl.channel_code
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_period, channel DESC
LIMIT 15
